claims.text: Large language models are prone to hallucination, generating plausible yet nonfactual content.
LLM hallucinations present distinct challenges that diverge from hallucination in prior task-specific models.
Retrieval-augmented LLMs face limitations in combating hallucinations.

evidence.description: LLMs are prone to hallucination, generating plausible yet nonfactual content.
Given the open-ended general-purpose attributes inherent to LLMs, LLM hallucinations present distinct challenges that diverge from prior task-specific models.
Additionally, we delve into the current limitations faced by retrieval-augmented LLMs in combating hallucinations...

methodologies.name: Literature Survey and Taxonomy
methodologies.description: Categorizes and reviews LLM hallucination detection, benchmark, and mitigation methodologies.

limitations.text: Retrieval-augmented LLMs face limitations in combating hallucinations.
